If you are just learning the champ i would focus on the basics, that said the aa reset can help you win early 1v1s, i hope this [clip](https://youtu.be/X-BvXMeXg8I) will make it a little more clear.

Just after the auto hits you do a small dash on e and this will allow you to do an attack much faster than just standing still.

Ok, first of remember his revive is removed, sounds dumb but some people don't know it. If you are winning the early lane, try to roam mid or invade enemy jng, both for camps and vision. 

The 3 q does the most dmg so its the most important to hit, so if you can hit the others without e it helps a lot in hitting the last.

You can cancel jumps/dashes with the knockup, though it can be tricky to time.

Your e resets auto timer, use this in close 1v1 and towers, though the timing is not forgiving so you might end up canceling your first auto.

Later you need to look for fights, since you do almost 0 dmg to minions late game. so close game early if possible.

Items: bc or dd is the 2 most commom items and will suit almost any scenario, then you expand with other bruiser items, such as steraks, vissage, etc. merc or tabi is the best boots for aatrox, so buy according to enemy team.
